blocks.text: Step into the Upside Down with these officially licensed Stranger Things t-shirts! Offered in both adult and kid’s sizes so the whole family can show off their love for the series. Choose from multiple styles including Hellfire Club, Hawkins High, and iconic Stranger Things graphics. Featuring bold, fan-favorite designs from the hit Netflix series, these shirts are a must-have for any Hawkins fan.

items: Officially licensed Stranger Things short sleeve graphic tee shirt
Rib knit crew neck collar; Soft hand screen print design; Stylish drop shoulder sleeves; Pull on closure; Acid wash fabric for a cool vintage look; Front and back graphic
Fashion tee with cool character designs you will love to wear; comfy top made from a soft clothing material that is safe on skin
Stylish graphic tshirt with a comfortable fit and an easy to dress design; durable and long-lasting outfit essential for your active lifestyle
Perfect for birthday gift, Christmas holiday gift, every day wear, outdoor play and warm spring and summer days
